messages:
mike: Heads-up — we're seeing a 5xx spike from prod-west on /v1/generate, traced to the canary SNI routing to model-variant:redwood-13b-quant. Latency also climbed 400ms->1200ms. Can we shunt traffic back to stable? :grimacing:

sara: On it. Is this the canary we flipped this morning? I saw a partial rollout ~2h ago.

mike: yeah, rollout id r-o-2026-03-18-7. Need an emergency hot-path: match by header `x-rw-model-version` and fallback to `redwood-13b-v2` when backend returns 5xx.

jen: proposed quick fix: set header rewrite + set-weight 0 for the canary via the gateway CLI. I can run if someone ack's.

ashley: +1. Outline steps? We need a rollback plan and a short console flag so downstream apps don't break.

mike: Steps I'll execute (keeping it minimal):

```
# 1) create emergency route with high priority
rictl route create --name emergency-shunt-2026-03-18 \
  --match 'path:/v1/generate && header:x-rw-model-version:~canary' \
  --action 'rewrite-header:x-rw-model-version:redwood-13b-v2; set-weight:canary=0' \
  --priority 1000

# 2) scope to prod-west only
rictl route attach --route emergency-shunt-2026-03-18 --env prod-west

# 3) monitor key metrics
rictl monitor route emergency-shunt-2026-03-18 --metric 5xx,latency
```

mike: I'll also annotate the rollout in Console and trigger quick smoke tests (text/generation sanity + short prompt set).

sara: ack. If you can run with `--dry-run` first that'd be great so the deploy-bot can sanity-check.

mike: doing dry-run now...

deploy-bot: Dry-run ok — no conflicts (conflict-check id: cck-3821). Automated suggestion: copy allowlist for `x-rw-client-id` from primary route.

jen: if dry-run is clean, do it. I'll watch dashboards (per-route 1m/5m) and have a rollback command ready: 

```
# rollback (fast)
rictl route delete emergency-shunt-2026-03-18 --force
# restore weights if needed
rictl route flip --name canary --weight 100
```

ashley: I'll stand up the canary-weight-reinstate playbook and prep the alert so SRE can execute if we see regressions. Also add short-term telemetry tag: `emergency_shunt=ts-1802233344` on traced requests.

mike: applying the route to prod-west now. Patch applied at 1802233460. Observing metrics... 5xx dropped to baseline within ~30s. :tada:

sara: Nice — leave route in place for 2 hours, then we can do a controlled re-roll with tracing flags enabled.

jen: created PR to add a postmortem checklist and a clearer Console "Emergency Route" CTA so the on-call doesn't need CLI next time: PR #3421.

ashley: can someone post a short incident note in #incidents with mitigation steps and CLI snippet? I'll attach traces and tracespan ids.

mike: posted in #incidents: https://redwood.incidents/1892 — included mitigation, smoke results, and the dry-run conflict id.

sara: closing thread after postmortem is merged. Great work all. :heart:
